# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with lovely fair, curly hair and brown or blue captivating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs larger than anyone else in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and broadminded teacher who possesses the gift of winning her students' affection and bringing out their best. She uses tactful and innovative methods to encourage independent thought and exploration, though her unconventional approaches sometimes shock traditional community members. She demonstrates patience, forgiveness, and firm guidance when dealing with misconduct, teaching her pupils to hold high moral standards.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as Avonlea's first female teacher, introducing various educational innovations such as biweekly recitation sessions, physical culture exercises, nature study field days, and composition practice. She organized a student concert on Christmas Night to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Recognizing potential in her advanced students, she formed an after-school class to prepare them for the Queen's Academy entrance examination. Though offered a job in her home district, she decided to return to Avonlea for a second year out of dedication to seeing her pupils through their entrance tests. Under her guidance, all of her Queen's candidates passed their exams, with Anne Shirley taking top honors. After ending her term at Avonlea, she later visited the area and remained a cherished friend and mentor to her former students.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P21](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Was hired as the first female teacher in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Was offered a position in her home district's grade school but chose to remain in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> But you’ve done good work this past year and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

> Yes, I think I will. I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
